description.text:
Basic Energy cards in the XY design, with a ©2013 line and no set symbol or collection number, in nine types; the Fairy Energy here was the first English print of that new type. Plain copies came in English products of the XY years such as Elite Trainer Boxes and the Kalos Starter Set; the Fairy Energy also came in the Sylveon Collection, released on 15 November 2013, and in the Resilient Life and Enchanted Echo theme decks.

Sheen holo copies came in Battle Arena Decks, among them Xerneas vs. Yveltal and Rayquaza vs. Keldeo.
